prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, late 20s goddess, violin hip hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, shaggy layered teal hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a scarf top made from a navy-bordered white triangular school scarf of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey folded around her bust, tied behind her neck and back, with its front corners knotted at the center of her chest under a small gold school pin and the two short ends hanging down, her shoulders, arms and midriff bare, and a micro pleated skirt of ultra-thin matte forest-green modal jersey with a thin white stripe along the hem, sitting at the top of her hip bones with a plain ultra-high slit up the left side from the hem to her hip bone, with the hem ending just below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and a small beauty mark near her lips. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the soft matte drape of the white modal jersey against her bare shoulders and the crisp pleats of the skirt, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, her legs fully in view — most extreme violin hip hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: platform shoes of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pastel pink leather sneakers with white laces, each built on a towering solid white rubber platform sole taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee, its tall side wall decorated with a wavy two-tone band in pink and white with a flowing wave line along the side wall, worn with white ankle socks with a ruffle trim, her feet held level on the flat tops of the platforms, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in forest green lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: large round eyes with bright real catchlights, thick curled lashes with drawn-on lower lashes, soft pink and lilac eyeshadow, round pink blush, glossy cherry-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows sweaty oiled skin, post-workout glistening.

Background: a bright waterfall viewpoint with a wooden deck, a waist-high wooden railing, stone steps of normal height and lush green cliffs behind her, in warm golden late-afternoon light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so her full height reads at a glance, her shoes planted flat on the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
